prompt: Who had the best career batting average out of every player to hit a home run in the 2002 World Series matchup between the Anaheim Angeles and San Francisco Giants?
answer:
Barry Bonds had the best career batting average among the players who hit a home run in the 2002 World Series: **.298**.

Bonds hit **four home runs** for the San Francisco Giants in the seven-game series. The next-highest was likely Garret Anderson at **.293**, followed by Jeff Kent at **.290**.
